name: test-summary
description: Draws a test or type-check run's output as one count line with its failures under it, the passing tests folded away (terminal)

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Turn this mod off without removing it. Takes effect at once.

nodeTest.title: node --test
nodeTest.description: Summarize a run of node --test (its spec reporter). Off, the engine draws its output.

bunTest.title: bun test and claude plugin test
bunTest.description: Summarize a run of bun test or claude plugin test. Off, the engine draws its output.

tsc.title: tsc
tsc.description: Count tsc's type errors, each with its place. Off, the engine draws its output.

failureLines.title: Lines of each failure
failureLines.description: How many lines of a failure's error are shown under it, its stack left out. copy failures copies them all.
